propositions: Eval pass reproducibility is confounded when Pass-1 runs on a different model than production baseline, since model capability differences (e.g. Sonnet vs Opus degradation) mask true delta measurement
Fallback chain resolution collapses prompt_cache_style to none when frontier and standard model classes disagree, causing cache reads to drop to zero and doubling review cost
The existing fallback suppression mechanism (no_chain check) only fires for offline test-double paths, not for live eval runs using real production models
PydanticAIRunner.run re-derives the fallback chain from resolved model string on every call, so a caller cannot suppress the fallback by constructing an empty fallback list
resolve_pinned_model must write an ephemeral rebar.toml with fallback=[] to a temp config root so that LLMConfig(repo_path=pinned.config_root) forces homogeneous chain resolution without fallback
Corpus sidecar rows must surface ran_model from provider_provenance to enable post-hoc model parity validation and cache effectiveness checking
